name: Verdant Crumbs #26
description:

ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Contains dormant, microscopic organisms that activate upon consumption, providing a subtle sensation of growth within the consumer.
TASTE: Mildly earthy with a hint of sweetness, similar to fresh sprouts.
